record_scope_reconstruction: The September 16 statement applies to six existing passenger land ports: Benapole, Akhaura, Sonamasjid, Hili, Darshana and Burimari. Four road passenger complexes are independently located; Hili and Darshana candidate railway/town points do not establish their passenger-control footprints. Five posts scheduled for September 19 are excluded.

source_checks.finding: Foreign-ministry statement expressly lists six current ports, removal of NOC condition and five different ports for later reopening.
LPAI distinguishes Hili LCS road port and proposed development from railway infrastructure; no numeric existing passenger gate point.
